_evidence: Record read by the tail of 0x0040d19f through [0x00627804] (the caller 0x40d389 stores its segment record there): dwords +0x100 / +0x10c are the clamp/divisor of the final idiv ((min(|eax|,ecx)<<14)/ecx with xor edx,edx), valid for 0..2^20 (0 is replaced by 1; a negative dword would overflow the idiv), words +0x108 / +0x114 any i16 (shl 6, imul/shrd).
